source.title: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries: South Korea, residence

calendar.note: Individual businesses file VAT for each half year by 25 July and 25 January, with preliminary notices paid by 25 April and 25 October. The comprehensive income tax return and payment are due on 31 May (30 June for faithful-reporting filers), with an interim prepayment on 30 November.

sources.title: NTS: VAT filing and payment deadlines

workdays.note: A filing or payment deadline on a Saturday, public holiday or Workers' Day (1 May) moves to the next day.
